title: Pattern: TRN-229 loses sync in the evening
description: Night NOC in Oulu sees TRN-229 lose sync around 21:10 and fixes it by resetting the timing port. Half of a linked pattern: TRN-131 in Rovaniemi drops traffic the same evening in another conversation (pattern-trn131-traffic-drop-evening). Neither mentions TRN-117, which both are linked to.
subject: #noc-night

messages.text: TRN-229 just lost sync, 21:10. Interfaces are UP but nothing passes. Anyone seen this on the Oulu TX-5000?
had that last week too. reset the timing port on it, sync comes back in a minute or two
Reset the timing port. Sync is back, traffic flowing again 👍
classic. no idea why it does that in the evening

items.summary: When TRN-229 loses sync in the evening (interfaces UP, no traffic), resetting the timing port brings sync back within minutes.
items.action: Reset the timing port; sync comes back within a minute or two.
items.evidence: seq 3: 'Sync is back, traffic flowing again'
